caption: The drawing features a central red heart with a green, twisted rope encircling its middle horizontally. Above the heart, there is a small brown cross. The heart is positioned within an oval, peach-colored background, which contains radiating red lines emanating outward from the heart, creating a sense of focus on the central figure. Surrounding the oval is a teal-green border that is enclosed within a red rectangle, with the entire composition outlined in a thick, uneven black and brown line. The drawing rests on a plain beige background, and a small number “50” is noted in the lower left corner.
title: Plate 50: Sacred Heart: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
